## Off-policy evaluation (SYNTHETIC world with known truth)

6,000 users, slate of 30 eligible titles each, logging policy (1-0.2) * softmax(z(log popularity)/0.5) + 0.2/K (min propensity 0.0067). 200 independent logs of 20,000 rounds. Reward model: LightGBM classifier, 2-fold cross-fitted, features: tt_score, log_pop, genre_affinity, knn_score, als_score, reranker_score.
